page.overview:
Who is Global Defense Agency Soldiers?

Guardians of the Globe Atom Eve Debbie Grayson Oliver Grayson

The Global Defense Agency soldiers are paramilitary troops who serve the Global Defense Agency.

Since the establishment of the Global Defense Agency, the paramilitary soldiers were created to work with the GDA.

Following the Guardians of the Globe's death, the GDA soldiers appeared to clear the area and was unaware that Nolan was the one who had killed the Guardians.
